claims.why_not_priced: Only two Stocktwits participants notice it in the whole 30-item capture, on 2026-08-06, and their reading is 'company pumping soon?!' - not an information read. There is no news search for this ticker (n_queries=0 in every sweep), no analyst coverage and no institutional following. The point is not the dollar size, which is trivial ($2k-$20k a clip), but the frequency and the liquidity: eleven consecutive purchases with zero sales, sized at a large fraction of the daily tape, in the run-in to a results release, is the clearest form of insider conviction available in an illiquid ADR - and the stock is still 63.4% below its 52-week high.
